description: Chain mutations (spec/SPEC.md §6.2), from chains of 2 to 8 hops that verify. F3: hops swapped, reversed, rotated. F4: a caveat dropped, appended or edited, the sig kept. F5: one exp raised. F6: an attacker posing as a principal. F7: (a) S + L on hop and envelope signatures; (b) the eight small-order Ed25519 points as a hop iss and as an envelope from, with R the identity and S = 0, over an arbitrary digest and over one ground so that the challenge k is 0 mod 8; (c) non-canonical encodings (y + p) of the identity and of the order-4 point, likewise.
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
